# Daily Report — 2026-10-30

## Task Completed
Added `update_field_definition` and `delete_field_definition` tools to complete
CRUD for the `sys_dictionary` table (field schema management).

- **update_field_definition** — PATCH `sys_dictionary/{sys_id}`; accepts
  `column_label`, `mandatory`, `read_only`, `default_value`, `max_length`,
  `comments`, `active`, `reference_qual`; empty-body guard; 404 guard; record can be
  identified by `sys_id` OR by `table_name` + `field_name` (auto-resolved via GET).
- **delete_field_definition** — DELETE `sys_dictionary/{sys_id}`; 404 guard;
  handles 204/200 success; same dual-identifier lookup.
- `_resolve_field_sys_id` helper encapsulates the lookup logic shared by both tools.
- Both registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages
  (config/tool_packages.yaml and tool_utils.py).
